external_reference_decisions.accepted_role: Official Retsinformation reference to BEK nr 1457/2020 and its version/status evidence. The government PDF printed 19 October 2026 marks the order Gældende and lists BEK nr 965/2025 as a later amendment. Use the 2020 text as the official base wording; read provisions changed by BEK nr 965/2025 together with that amending instrument. This acceptance does not mean the PDF integrates that amendment.
not_accepted: A single consolidated text integrating BEK nr 965/2025.
Resolution of the end-date conflict in the local XML conversion metadata.
Proof that no other later amendment or commencement issue exists.
The local Markdown conversion as an accepted current text, topic adequacy, or country completion.

evidence.version: BEK nr 1457 af 06/10/2020; official PDF labels it Gældende and lists BEK nr 965 af 18/06/2025 as a later change.
evidence.verified_locations: Official PDF cover/status and later-change list; §§ 1-3 identify EU, EEA, Swiss, Danish-returnee and Nordic scope.
evidence.research_browser_note: The ELI HTML view returned a JavaScript shell; the official PDF body and status metadata were directly readable.
evidence.retrieval_limit: The retained local XML conversion reports an end date of 2026-07-02, which conflicts with the official PDF status seen on 2026-10-19. The conflict remains open; this external-reference decision does not promote the local conversion.

external_reference_decisions.accepted_role: Official primary text of BEK nr 965/2025, accepted for its exact amendment instructions to EU-opholdsbekendtgørelsen and its stated commencement on 1 July 2025. The text changes provisions including §§ 14, 18, 24, 26, 29-31 and 36, and repeals §§ 37-38. Read it with the BEK nr 1457/2020 base text where those changes matter.
not_accepted: A standalone consolidated version of the EU-opholdsbekendtgørelsen.
Proof of the fully integrated wording of every affected provision.
Proof that no later amendment exists beyond the version/status evidence reviewed.
A locally stored copy or country-level coverage completion.

evidence.version: BEK nr 965 af 18/06/2025; § 2 states commencement on 1 July 2025.
evidence.verified_locations: Complete three-page official PDF; §§ 1-2 identify the amended order, changed provisions, repeals, and commencement date.
evidence.retrieval_limit: No exact response bytes were stored locally. The decision accepts the official external reference within this stated scope only.

policy: A clear government-published legal source may be accepted for direct reference within its displayed status, version, content, and caveats. Gazette amendment-chain reconstruction is not a blanket prerequisite. External-reference acceptance is separate from local-copy acceptance, topic adequacy, and country completion.
count_note: accepted_source_count and accepted_current_law_source_count count accepted retained local artifacts; both remain 0. Two official external references are accepted within the narrow scopes above. No Danish local conversion was promoted by this review.
